admission.justification: The form, tray interception and Send state must agree so a click cannot create a seat before Send or duplicate its first request.

applicability: The leaf's explainer first-request form, its build request and later Explain action.
conditions: The active leaf address matches the pending/request event.
The Send has references, text or stale work to send.
exclusions: Mixed archived/live ordinary tray sends retain the existing live-target settlement semantics; this proposal asserts collection preservation only for the sole archived/placeholder branch.
The backend owns final message composition and process/agent construction.

evidence: dashboard/src/explainer/ExplainerColumn.test.tsx::leaves the placeholder on Cancel, and no seat or environment exists before Send; dashboard/src/explainer/ExplainerColumn.test.tsx::keeps his request when the build fails, and names the step; dashboard/src/explainer/ExplainerColumn.test.tsx::never posts a second build for a second press while the first runs; dashboard/src/explainer/ExplainerColumn.test.tsx::opens the first-request form with the tray’s picks and intercepts native tray Send; source-location and unchanged-byte audit: helpers/frontend/source-drift-current-W9.json; no fresh test execution.

statement: With no explainer seat, Explain, a new reference or Send to an archived target opens the fixed-target request form without starting anything, and only explicit Send submits its references, notes and unchanged text under one stable request id with concurrent-press refusal and retryable failure, while later Explain only adds a change-set reference.
